sentences.text: 1. Ugam Singh Rajpurohit S/o Uday Singh Rajpurohit, Aged  About 61 Years, R/o Village Punadiya, Dist. Pali, At  Relevant Time Tehsildar, Deogarh, Rajsamand.

2. Kailash Chand Bunker S/o Mangi Lal Ji, Aged About 51  Years, R/o Chandelaki Gawar, Chaapli, Dist. Rajsamand.
 At Relevant Time Land Revenue Inspector, Deogarh,
 Rajsamand.
 ----Petitioners  Versus 1. State Of Rajasthan, Through Pp 2.

Vima Devi W/o Hari Singh, R/o Nandawat Bhim, Bheem,
 Dist. Rajsamand.
----Respondents For Petitioner(s) : Mr. R.S. Chouhan For Respondent(s) : Mr. Vikram Rajpurohit, PP  with Mr. R.S. Bhati  HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE ARUN MONGA Order 12/09/2024 1.
Quashing of an FIR No.41/2023, dated 05.02.2023, registered at P.S. Deogarh, District Rajsamand, for the offences under Sections 420, 466, 467 and 120-B of IPC, is sought herein.

2. At the very outset learned Public Prosecutor on instruction submits that the police, after investigation, has prepared negative final report and same will be filed in the competent court in due course of time.
3. Needful be done as expeditiously as possible.
4. In view of the statement made by learned Public Prosecutor, challenge to the FIR in question is rendered infructuous.
